data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 冬夜壁炉前的信
data.description: 旅馆壁炉前，她就着火光给故乡方向写一封没有收件人的信，耳朵低垂；写完后把信纸仔细折好收进怀里——有些思念不需要寄出。
data.action: 旅馆壁炉前，她就着火光给故乡方向写一封没有收件人的信，耳朵低垂
data.promptProse: Raphtalia writes a letter toward home beside the inn fireplace, her ears lowered over a burgundy sweater and wool shawl. After finishing, she carefully folds the unsigned paper and tucks it close, long brown skirt gathered by the chair. The medium portrait includes the hearth and small writing surface. Firelight warms her finger joints and page edge, leaving quieter shadows behind the chair and between the folded shawl layers.
